messages:
devin: Hey @marie @sahil — I pushed the follow-ups from the review on the canary rollout PR. Short summary: added a rollback TTL guard, made the cancel path idempotent, tightened metric labels, and added a smoke e2e that flips the feature flag. Changelog + runbook note included. PTAL when you have ~10–15m: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/432

marie: Thanks — I'll skim now. Two quick asks: 1) add a small changelog blurb (one sentence) explaining the rollback behavior change, 2) is the TTL configurable per-cluster or hardcoded? if it's hardcoded let's make it configurable.

devin: Changelog blurb added in the PR (see last commit). TTL is config-backed via DEFAULT_ROLLBACK_TTL (defaults to 5m) and can be overridden per-cluster; updated the docs snippet and runbook to mention it. Squashed WIP commits into one; left the transient-flake fix as a separate commit for traceability. PTAL again.

sahil: LGTM on the core logic. Left one nit about controller log level (should be debug not info). Also saw a transient flake on the smoke earlier — can you re-run the smoke job before we land?

devin: Re-ran the smoke just now, CI is green. Fixed the log level nit and squashed. Kept the test-flake retry as a separate commit with a short note. If @marie is happy, would like to land in the 14:00 canary window.

marie: :eyes: Reviewing the final commit. If CI stays green and the log nit is fixed I'm happy to approve. One small ask: add a single line under "Rollback behavior" in the runbook summarizing TTL and manual rollback steps.

devin: Added the runbook line and pushed. CI passed again. ci-bot: build passed (main/test-suite) :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: build passed — inference/branch:canary-432 — all checks green.

marie: LGTM :shipit: — I'll merge to canary after a final quick smoke in staging. Can someone own watching the metrics for the first 30m post-deploy?

sahil: I'll take metrics watch + slack alerts. If we see error-rate or latency spikes I'll trigger the rollback and ping infra.

devin: Thanks — I'll pair with you on rollback steps if needed. Marking this as merged from my side.
